[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Teph''' was a member of the [[Kiffu Guardians]]. In [[137 ABY]], Teph tried to stop a brawl near the [[Busted Blaster]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], along with subordinates [[Griz (Kiffar)|Griz]] and [[Ahnah Rawk]], but the Guardians were beaten by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] named [[Cade Skywalker]].<ref name="Legacy 35" />
